title: Introducing scipy.stats
learning_objectives: Create frozen distribution objects with scipy.stats.norm and scipy.stats.binom
Use pdf/pmf, cdf, ppf, mean and std on a distribution object
Check library results against the formulas you implemented by hand
hints: Validate first, then build `dist = stats.norm(loc=mu, scale=sigma)` or `stats.binom(n, p)`.
The density method is `dist.pdf(x)` for the normal and `dist.pmf(x)` for the binomial.
Convert every result with `float(...)` before putting it in the dict.

failure_feedback.advice: `scale` is the standard deviation σ, and ppf takes a probability q.
Check the parameters yourself before calling SciPy; it returns nan instead of raising.
